scope: Every recorded receiver, law and separation, each with five recorded senders.
observable: The archive saves complete own-birth counts and own-short counts per recorded round. It saves the first differences and classes derived from birth signatures. The per-round birth signatures are absent.
common comparison: The common window ends at the earliest stop among the five sender runs.
pairwise comparison: Each pair can be compared until that pair stops. A late difference still needs an eligible prefix. An unobserved round is unresolved.
